changelog: Recalibrate (v3.15.0 rules firing on artifacts, not real problems): RISK_SIZE_SKEW threshold 1.15 -> 1.25 and severity critical -> info (new severity tier, see below) -- fired at the account's real 1.08 skew, which should be silent. RISK_TIER_BREACH message now names which months the breaches fall in, not just a count -- 11 breaches in one week reads differently from 11 spread across four months. RISK_LADDER_DRIFT threshold <85% -> <70% -- fired at the account's real 74.6% baseline; message now splits over-tier vs. under-tier counts, since oversizing and undersizing are different failures
Add: 'info' as a fourth insight severity (alongside alert/watch/good) for context that isn't a problem -- js/review.js REVIEW_SEVERITY gains a blue INFO style; getReview()'s sort order updated

Add: Size Integrity panel footnote -- dollars-per-R is Sigma dollars / Sigma R across the resolved population (a P&L-weighted harmonic mean of risk), not AVG(risk_amount). Not comparable to an arithmetic-mean risk figure

Add: trades.balance_at_day_start / target_r / exit_quality (nullable). Backfilled for challenge 6: target_r from (take_profit-entry_price)/(entry_price-stop_loss), signed (no direction branch needed -- worked correctly for both Long and Short by construction, and exposes direction-blind geometry errors as a negative value instead of masking them); balance_at_day_start as the running balance before the first trade of each trade_date; exit_quality derived from target_r x exit_reason (target_hit_valid/target_hit_short/stopped_valid/stopped_short/manual_close/unknown, 2.5 target_r threshold)

Fix: risk-ladder tier basis moves from balance_at_entry (exact trade time) to balance_at_day_start (start of day) -- 27 of challenge 6's 59 trades sat within $250 of the $9,500 boundary, so an at-entry basis let a trade's own tier flip mid-session purely because an earlier same-day trade closed first. planned_risk_pct and risk_deviation_pct recomputed across all 59 rows against the new basis; balance_at_entry stays stored, just no longer used for tier assignment

Finding: three 'Take Profit' exits paid 0.88R/0.94R/1.01R against a >=2.5 target_r gate -- the target was set at roughly 1R, not the ~3:1 the strategy requires. Invisible under exit_reason alone (Bitfunded's label is not a judgement); now surfaced by EXIT_TARGET_SHORT

Add: ReviewEngineController v3.7.0 -> v3.8.0, fifteen new rule methods (additive -- no existing rule, Phase 0's 20 or Phase 1's 3, was rewritten): Repetition (REP_NO_CLEAN_REPS, REP_TEMPLATE_EXISTS, REP_FIELDS, REP_NO_DENOMINATOR), Exit Quality (EXIT_TARGET_SHORT, EXIT_QUALITY_UNKNOWN, EXIT_VALID_HELD), Edge recorded/estimated split (EDGE_RECORDED_ONLY, EDGE_UNPROVEN, EDGE_NEGATIVE, EDGE_INTERVENTION_POSITIVE), Cost (COST_EXCEEDS_LOSS, COST_DRAG, COST_FLIPPED), Geometry (GEO_RATIO_DRIFT)

Note: fee_drag_R/fee_drag_pct and purchased_ratio/live_boundary_ratio/ratio_drift formulas were not given explicit definitions in either briefing this was built from -- only conditions and message templates. Derived and documented in CLAUDE.md v3.16.0 (fee_drag_R in the same $-per-R unit dollars_per_R_winners already uses; ratio_drift from profit_target_amt/max_loss_amt vs. the same ratio recomputed against current balance) -- flagged for review, not silently assumed correct

Deferred: item 6 (CadenceGate, daily/weekly/monthly cadence gating and computed-action verification) is not in this release. It references an 'original §6' this session was never given the text of -- everything else in this briefing shipped; item 6 follows once that text is provided
